name: smwgraphics-jumper-vt369-underwater
title: Jumper (VT369) - Underwater
description:
This is the underwater/sewer tileset from Jumper on the VT369, which is a blatant copy of Super Mario Bros. on the NES
Since this tileset gave me sewer vibes, I've decided to double down on that idea, I was originally going to make the water green, but I didn't want to make it brown like in the original, not only because I sort of found it kinda gross (not really), but I was also afraid it would've blended with the ground.
